tagline: Leader in convenient nutrition with Premier Protein and Dymatize brands
hero_kpi_rationale: Robust 16% year-over-year growth, demonstrating expansion of the Premier Protein and Dymatize brand portfolios and increased distribution channel penetration

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total net sales of the company
kpis.description: Net sales increased $320.4 million, or 16%, to $2,316.6 million in the year ended September 30, 2025 compared to $1,996.2 million in 2024, driven by 15% higher volumes in Premier Protein and 23% higher volumes in Dymatize
kpis.signal: Net sales grew 16% in fiscal 2025 driven by Premier Protein distribution gains and Dymatize international expansion

kpis.name: Operating Profit
kpis.description: Operating profit decreased $30.3 million, or 8%, to $357.4 million in the year ended September 30, 2025 compared to $387.7 million in 2024, primarily driven by a $69.0 million provision for legal matters and $72.1 million higher net product costs, partially offset by accelerated amortization of $17.4 million in the prior year
kpis.signal: Operating profit declined 8% in fiscal 2025 due to legal provisions and elevated input costs, partially offset by revenue growth

kpis.name: Net Earnings
kpis.description: Net earnings decreased $30.3 million, or 12%, to $216.2 million in the year ended September 30, 2025 compared to $246.5 million in 2024, reflecting the impact of the legal provision, higher input costs and increased interest expense, partially offset by lower income tax expense
kpis.signal: Net earnings decreased 12% in fiscal 2025 due to operating profit decline and higher interest expense

risks.title: Concentration in RTD Protein Shakes
risks.score_rationale: 81.7% of net sales are derived from RTD protein shakes; a significant decline in this category would materially adversely affect the company's financial performance

risks.title: Intense Competitive Environment
risks.score_rationale: The convenient nutrition category is highly competitive with numerous branded and private label competitors; competitive pressures could impact market share and pricing

risks.title: Supply Chain Disruption Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on third-party manufacturers and suppliers; disruptions in manufacturing capacity or supply chains could impair the ability to produce and distribute products

risks.title: Supplier Concentration Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on a limited number of suppliers for certain ingredients and packaging materials; loss of a key supplier could disrupt operations

risks.title: Input Cost Inflation
risks.score_rationale: Raw material, packaging and manufacturing costs faced inflationary pressures in fiscal 2025; continued inflation and announced tariffs could further increase supply chain costs and impact margins

risks.title: Changing Consumer Preferences
risks.score_rationale: The company must continuously identify and respond to changing consumer preferences in nutrition and wellness; failure to innovate and meet evolving needs could impact sales and competitive position
